lines.japanese:

スペックに安定するよう育成される。
　優秀な者などは加速処置を施されクラスアップすることもあるが、クラスＢま
で含めれば結構な数とはいえ、あくまで例外的処置と言える。
lines.english: USERs are ordinarily expected to function as individual terminals and are therefore trained to maintain average specifications. Exceptional individuals may receive acceleration treatment and move up a class. Although their numbers are substantial if Class B is included, such treatment remains exceptional.

lines.japanese:
本クラスに属する現象行使者は、最初から一定の目的をもって機能強化が施さ
れる。　端末としてではなく、現場レベルで有用な現象力（実行＆制圧力）を発
揮することが期待されるのである。
lines.english: Phenomenon operators in this class undergo functional enhancement for a specific purpose from the outset. Rather than act as terminals, they are expected to wield phenomenal power that is useful in the field—execution and suppression capability.

lines.japanese:
そのためこのクラスの子供は、クラスＡ～Ｂなどと同様の兵役・訓練義務を有
する。
lines.english: Children in this class are therefore subject to the same military-service and training obligations as those in Classes A through B.

lines.japanese:

lines.english: They often receive no acceleration treatment, however, and their specifications are frequently inferior to those of other classes.

lines.japanese:

lines.english: Class D—the Designed Children—are irregular phenomenon operators whose enhancements emphasize execution capability.
